μεθίστημι: to place in another way, to change
περιγίγνομαι: to be superior to; to survive
προαφίσταμαι: secede, revolt before; to leave off, depart from before
συνίστημι: to set together, combine, associate, unite, band together
ἀνίστημι: to make to stand up, raise up
ἀπανίστημι: to make rise up and depart, send away
ἀπονίναμαι: have the use or enjoyment of a thing
ἐξίστημι: to put out of its place, to change
ἐξανίστημι: to raise up: to make one rise
ἐφίστημι: to set on, over; set in charge of
ὑφίστημι: to place under; mid. to submit, to promise
